body: the term “Arctic” refers to the entire region north of the Arctic Circle

we use the definition set by the International Maritime Organization (IMO), the United Nations agency responsible for the safety and security of shipping and the prevention of pollution by ships. The IMO set this definition,
the U.S. Arctic is bounded by a line at 60 degrees north
